enchantments.tooltip: +12 Enhancement Bonus: +12 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Shield Bashing +20%: +20% Enhancement bonus to your chance of a Secondary Shield Bash. This stacks with bonuses granted by any relevant feats.
Maiming: This weapon has a twisted haft or grip and spikes along its blade, head, or point. When you score a critical hit with this weapon, it does an additional +6d8 damage.
Bashing 6: This shield is exceptionally durable and dense, and does an additional 6d6 damage when used to shield bash.
Riposte +6: This item enchants its user with incredible awareness and speed, granting a +6 Insight bonus to AC and to Saves.
